t: Clear oil-wax combination based on natural oils and waxes, for treating wooden furniture and worktops. Microporous surface will not crack, peel, flake or blister. Resistant to saliva, perspiration, and liquids such as wine, beer, cola, coffee, tea, fruit juice and milk. Dry finish is safe for humans, animals and plants. Ideal for flooring. Suitable for childrens toys.
